title: Lufthansa Snags TAP, Delta Gets Fancy, and Riyadh Air Flees Its Own Airport
summary: Lufthansa looks set to win a key stake in TAP Air Portugal, beating out Air France-KLM in a fight that's been brewing for years. Plus, Delta rolls out $200 bottles of wine in Delta One, Riyadh Air evacuates its brand-new Dreamliners as missile attacks continue, and Airbus drops some numbers on just how many workers this industry is going to need.
